### Quarto Organisation

The project contains one master Quarto document (master.qmd) which combines seven individual .qmd sections. Each member workson their assigned sections before the complete report is rendered.

### Git Branching and Review Strategy

Each member develops their work in a separate Git branch which corresponds to one of the sub-seven quarto documents and submits a pull request. Another member reviews the changes before the project manager merges them into `main`.
